item.title: Parks and Rec closes outdoor rinks for the season

item.title: Gov. Rhoden vetoes bill to ban lab grown meat, calls for a moratorium
item.description: South Dakota Governor Larry Rhoden is trying to strike a compromise on lab grown meat. Governor Rhoden vetoed House Bill 1077 which would have labeled cell cultured meat as “adulterated food” basically banning its sale in South Dakota and is advocating for SB124.
